name: BTR-80
description: A heavily armoured 8-wheeled military personnel carrier designed for transporting troops across difficult terrain. Features all-wheel drive, locked differentials and a reinforced chassis. Offers substantial cargo capacity and multiple external storage attachment points, making it suitable for military transport and long-range operations.
externalStorage: 2 x 55-gallon Barrels, 4 x Wooden Crates, 1 x Sea Chest

name: Dodge Power Wagon
description: A rugged all-wheel-drive utility truck with a manual gearbox and a range of external storage attachment points. Its cargo capacity and ability to carry additional barrels or a wooden crate make it a practical vehicle for transporting supplies and equipment.
externalStorage: 4 x 55-gallon Barrels and 1 x Wooden Crate
access: Car Battery, Car Radiator, Spark Plug and 4 wheels

name: F1 Pickup
description: A rugged all-wheel-drive pickup truck with a manual gearbox, designed for transporting equipment and supplies. Offers generous internal storage and multiple external attachment points for barrels, wooden crates and a camo net.
access: Car Battery, Car Radiator, Spark Plug and 4 wheels

name: GAZ-12
description: A classic all-wheel-drive passenger car with a manual gearbox. Offers seating for four and a useful cargo area, with additional attachment points for two wooden crates. A distinctive vehicle with practical storage capacity.
access: Car Battery, Car Radiator, Spark Plug and 4 wheels

name: GAZ-13 Chaika
description: A classic Soviet luxury passenger car featuring all-wheel drive and a spacious interior. Offers substantial internal storage, additional equipment attachment points and a choice of manual or automatic transmission. A comfortable vehicle for travelling in style.
access: Car Battery, Car Radiator, Spark Plug and 4 wheels
gearbox: Manual (3 forward gears + reverse) or Automatic

name: GAZ-51
description: A rugged Soviet-era utility truck built for hauling supplies and equipment across difficult terrain. Features all-wheel drive, a spacious cargo area and extensive external storage. A practical workhorse for transport and logistics.
externalStorage: 4 x Wooden Crates and 4 x 55-Gallon Barrels
requirements: Truck Battery, Car Radiator, Spark Plug and 4 wheel attachment positions (6 physical wheels)

name: GAZ-53
description: A heavy-duty, all-wheel-drive Soviet cargo truck designed for transporting equipment and supplies across difficult terrain. Available in standard flatbed and petrol truck configurations, with a large internal cargo area.
requirements: 4 x Wheel Attachment Positions (6 physical wheels)
